<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ProductOrder"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/product-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerInquiry" name="Customer inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerApproval" name="Customer approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ProductOrder" name="Product order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ProductOrder">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesSupport" name="Sales staff or customer support">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_CustomerInquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CustomerInterest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesRepresentative" name="Sales representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GuideSelection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideQuote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CustomerApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerInquiry" name="Customer inquires about product or service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerInquiry" messageRef="Message_CustomerInquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information and address concerns or questions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerInterest" name="Is the customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide customer through selecting product or service"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote to customer" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerApproval" name="Customer approves quote">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerApproval" messageRef="Message_CustomerApproval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderConfirmed" name="Order successfully placed and confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotInterested" name="Customer not interested"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inquiry_Collect" sourceRef="Start_CustomerInquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Interest" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerInterest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Interested" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterest" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customer is interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="Not interested" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterest" targetRef="End_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guide_Quote" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quote_Approval" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Event_CustomerApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Event_CustomerApproval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Place_Record" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_End" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ProductOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SalesProcess" name="Sales process" processRef="Process_ProductOrder"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerInquiry" name="Customer inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_CustomerInquiry" messageRef="Message_CustomerInquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerApproval" name="Customer approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_CustomerApproval" messageRef="Message_CustomerApproval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
